title: vfs: touch'ing files makes them look empty

milestone.title: Known Problem
milestone.description: This milestone contains issues which are known problems which are proving difficult to fix, or are awaiting an external fix or we haven't got round to yet.

body:
When using `touch` on a vfs mounted file, the modification time and file size is wrong until the directory cache gets dropped.

```bash
$ date
Sa 27. Jan 16:13:15 CET 2018
$ ll /tmp/tmp.HnHyfvIWP6/touchtest
-rw-r--r-- 1 fabian fabian 29 27. Jan 16:10 date.txt
$ touch /tmp/tmp.HnHyfvIWP6/touchtest/date.txt
$ ll /tmp/tmp.HnHyfvIWP6/touchtest
-rw-r--r-- 1 fabian fabian 0 27. Jan 15:58 date.txt       # empty file and wrong modtime

# wait for directory cache dropp
$ ll /tmp/tmp.HnHyfvIWP6/touchtest
-rw-r--r-- 1 fabian fabian 29 27. Jan 16:13 date.txt       # correct size and modtime
```

> What is your rclone version (eg output from `rclone -V`)

rclone v1.39-083-gbc3ee977                                         
- os/arch: linux/amd64
- go version: go1.9.2
> Which OS you are using and how many bits (eg Windows 7, 64 bit)

Linux 4.14.14 # 1-NixOS SMP Wed Jan 17 08:45:30 UTC 2018 x86_64 GNU/Linux
> Which cloud storage system are you using? (eg Google Drive)

Google Drive
> The command you were trying to run (eg `rclone copy /tmp remote:tmp`)

rclone mount -vv --dir-cache-time 1h TestDrive: /tmp/tmp.HnHyfvIWP6
